title: SZED at ArGuard Shared Tasks: Multi-Task Label-Attention and Cross-Modal Fusion for Arabic Hateful Meme Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.26972v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present SZED's submission to ArGuard 2026 Track A: Arabic hateful meme detection. The task has two parts: binary classification (A1) and fine-grained multi-label tagging (A2). For A1, we fuse MARBERTv2 and CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings, comparing concatenation, self-attention, and ensemble heads. For A2, we use a multi-task label-attention architecture with per-class query vectors and an auxiliary head for cascade calibration. We reach macro-F1 = 0.7597 on A1 and 0.3142 on A2 (averaged over 10 active classes). We report reproducibility across runs, per-class error patterns, and the effect of cascade calibration on the long-tailed A2 label space.

translated_title: SZED参加ArGuard共享任务：面向阿拉伯语仇恨表情包检测的多任务标签注意力与跨模态融合方法
translated_abstract: 我们展示了SZED团队参加ArGuard 2026赛道A（阿拉伯语仇恨表情包检测）的提交方案。该任务包含两个部分：二分类（A1）和细粒度多标签标注（A2）。对于A1，我们融合了MARBERTv2和CLIP ViT-L/14的嵌入表示，并比较了拼接、自注意力和集成头三种融合方式。对于A2，我们采用多任务标签注意力架构，为每个类别设置独立的查询向量，并使用辅助头进行级联校准。我们在A1上达到macro-F1 = 0.7597，在A2上达到0.3142（对10个活跃类别取平均）。我们报告了多次运行结果的可复现性、各类别的错误模式，以及级联校准对长尾分布A2标签空间的影响。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种融合MARBERTv2文本嵌入与CLIP视觉嵌入的多任务标签注意力架构，并引入级联校准机制，用于阿拉伯语仇恨表情包检测，在二分类任务上取得macro-F1 0.7597、在细粒度多标签任务上取得0.3142的成绩。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-task label-attention architecture with cross-modal fusion of MARBERTv2 and CLIP embeddings and cascade calibration for Arabic hateful meme detection, achieving macro-F1 of 0.7597 on binary classification and 0.3142 on fine-grained multi-label tagging.
